family: C-Gate SESSION_ID on an owned loopback command session

obligations.outcome: A connected loopback client can query its own cmdN session identity with a 300 reply; an unknown SESSION_ID selector returns 400 without changing that identity.
preconditions: owned loopback listener with no project or physical network
preservation: query and syntax error leave the session identity and C-Bus state unchanged
obligations.implementation_basis: in_progress: cmqttd and cgate-mock implement the observed loopback query, but authorization and response-event variants remain partial
obligations.differential_gap: The nine-case payload capture omits client-tag prefixes; a separate eleven-case native capture and cmqttd differential now cover exact numeric-tag reply envelopes on two owned loopback sessions. Other tag forms and access-policy variants remain open.
obligations.physical_candidate_reason: The source-bound C-Gate contract classifies this query as command-session-only with no bus I/O, and the native capture opened no physical network. Physical bus behavior is outside this scoped loopback outcome.

obligations.outcome: A connected loopback client can list the internal Console and live external command sessions in 300 continuation framing with origin, connection time and optional one-shot tag; trailing words are ignored in the observed profile.
preconditions: owned loopback listener with no project or physical network
preservation: listing does not change another session, any project, or C-Bus state
obligations.implementation_basis: in_progress: cmqttd and cgate-mock list the native-shaped internal Console row and live external sessions, and remove closed peers, but access-policy variants remain open
obligations.differential_gap: The nine-case payload differential requires the internal Console cmd1 row and CRLF; a separate eleven-case native differential also matches numeric tags on every continuation and terminal row. Other tag forms and access-policy or session variants remain open.
obligations.physical_candidate_reason: The source-bound C-Gate contract classifies this listing as command-session-only with no bus I/O, and the native capture opened no physical network. Physical bus behavior is outside this scoped loopback outcome.

obligations.outcome: A connected loopback client can assign one tag to its own command session, with native command whitespace collapsed to single spaces; a second assignment returns 408 and a missing tag returns 400 without replacing the first tag.
preconditions: owned loopback listener with no project or physical network
preservation: failed reassignment leaves the first tag and all other sessions unchanged
no project or C-Bus state changes
obligations.implementation_basis: in_progress: cmqttd and cgate-mock cover one-shot assignment and observed errors, but other authorization and selector variants remain open
obligations.differential_gap: The scoped payload and numeric-tag wire differentials cover the observed one-shot assignment, rejection and missing-tag cases. Tag length, quoting and ACCESS/LOGIN variants remain open.
obligations.physical_candidate_reason: The source-bound C-Gate contract classifies this tag operation as command-session-only with no bus I/O, and the native capture opened no physical network. Physical bus behavior is outside this scoped loopback outcome.
